text:
Lena Ortiz: Heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8610 needs a reviewer. It's a small docs fix: update Go SDK snippet and a changed link in the migration checklist. CI is failing on `gofmt` in the example file. Can someone grab before EOD CET?

Theo Martin: I can try the Go snippet but I'm on PST schedule today. if it's just fmt I can fix quickly. who has merge perms for docs today?

Priya Nair: rotation owner is Marta this week I think, but Marta is OOO until later. @docs-rotation any fallback?

Marta Lopez: I'm out until 18:00 CET, can handle merge after that if someone leaves a +1.

Theo Martin: okay i'll run the snippet locally and push a `gofmt` commit. quick question: the snippet uses `NewClientWithConfig` which we deprecated — should we switch to `NewClient` in examples?

Lena Ortiz: yes please move to `NewClient({ region: "us-west-2" })` — we made that change in the runtime spec. also add a short compatibility note in the PR body about Go SDK v0.8+ vs v0.7.

Priya Nair: adding to that — tag it `docs-quick-merge` if it's only a formatting and naming change. that helps reviewers prioritize.

build-bot: CI build queued for PR #8610. checks: build pending, linkcheck pending, fmt-check failed on /examples/go/snippet.go: line 12.

Theo Martin: pushed a fmt fix and replaced `NewClientWithConfig` with `NewClient`. also added "compatible: go>=0.8" to PR description. preview link: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr/8610/1

build-bot: Re-run checks triggered by Theo Martin. fmt-check passed. linkcheck failing: /guides/migration anchor changed to `#auth-v2`.

Priya Nair: I can update the migration link briefly. Is the anchor `#auth-v2` safe? we changed it in the migration guide last sprint.

Lena Ortiz: yes use `#auth-v2`. also add a redirect snippet to `/guides/migration` mentioning the old anchor for a couple weeks to avoid broken external links.

Marta Lopez: back online. saw the PR — if it's green I can merge. can someone confirm nothing else depends on the old `NewClientWithConfig` name in examples?

Theo Martin: confirmed — I grepped examples and only that one file used old name. replaced and ran `go vet` locally. all good.

Priya Nair: updated migration guide anchor and added a short redirect note. re-triggering linkcheck.

build-bot: linkcheck passed. all checks green for PR #8610.

Marta Lopez: merging now. adding note: reminder to rotation owners to include backup reviewers in the calendar event (2nd fallback). filing a docs rotation follow-up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal/issues/512 (assigning to docs-rotation).

Lena Ortiz: thanks!! small request for the follow-up: include a one-liner in onboarding on when to label `docs-quick-merge` vs `docs-major-change`. that was unclear last month.

Priya Nair: good call. i'll draft that onboarding blurb and link to the runbook.

Theo Martin: nice teamwork. closing thread.
